passes.scope: Implement and verify end-to-end against official sources and recorded evaluators
actions: Audited all 9 priority repositories (GEMSDOE24, 25, 27, 28, 30, 31, 32, 33, 36) and 2026-10-25 sibling runs; verified GEMSDOE32 h33-h33-2-b2-20261004T220000Z-e5eb6e7e-zeros (0.2778 OWNER-REPORTED) and diagnosed GEMSDOE24 GVC1 (0.0859 OWNER-REPORTED) in-sample halo collapse.
Preregistered 4 ranked untried geological hypotheses (H24-TRSG1, H24-EULER2, H24-DRAIN3, H24-INSAR4) in commit a361bd8 before writing model code.

Implemented streaming 44-channel H24-TRSG1 feature stack, selective nuisance residualizer, terrain-relief LiDAR-gap calibrator, and Dual-Partition Stitched-OOF Two-Regime allocator; verified 3 arms on SegmentHoldout (0.14644 primary, paired +0.01644 [+0.00053, +0.03163] vs oof_multiphysics_hgb_d3), 3.0 km bridge (0.14674), 137-raster novelty (0.6293 <= 0.70), and exact-file C2ST (0.4727, Holm p=1.000).
Exported unique -zeros.tif, -nan.tif, -zeros.zip, <=140-char note, and fail-closed schema-v2 .preflight.json; integrated trsg1_packet into GitHub Pages and README.

passes.scope: Hunt and fix bugs, missing requirements, incorrect assumptions, and edge cases
findings_and_fixes: Fixed Gaussian second-derivative DC leak on uniform inputs by replacing discrete gaussian_filter(..., order=2) with Gaussian smoothing (order=0, truncate=4.0) + central second differences (0.0 twist leak verified in unit test).
Added fail-closed implicit-rerun refusal guard to scripts/run_trsg1_lane.py (--run refuses to overwrite frozen evidence/trsg1_experiment_20261026.json) and tested it in tests/test_trsg1.py.

Hardened verify_recorded() in scripts/run_trsg1_lane.py to verify ZIP outer SHA-256, inner GeoTIFF SHA-256, and preregistration file existence using strictly git-tracked files (zero gitignored data/ dependency in CI).
Preserved len(registry/live_scores.json['artifacts']) == 24 contract while recording 9-site and 2026-10-25 owner-reported scores under portfolio_9site_and_20261025_owner_reports.
Reverted timestamp-only touch on frozen evidence/access_inputs.json and added root executive-summary.html to automated broken-link tests in tests/test_site_build.py.
